name: OWASP ZAP
description: Add-on marketplace: JARs verified by SHA256 from the same unsigned manifest that gives the URL.
limitations: AI-generated static source analysis. Confirm the affected version, platform, update channel, and cited control flow before relying on this classification.

later_review_audit.description: In the reviewed ZAP add-on path, each add-on entry supplies a URL and an algorithm-qualified hash through ZapVersions.xml; the downloader computes that digest and only marks a matching file validated before installation. This is an integrity check tied to the retrieved manifest, not evidence that the manifest or its transport is cryptographically signed.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than historical release re-verification; the reviewed source does not establish authentication or signing of ZapVersions.xml, and external release artifacts were not inspected.

original_evidence.text: | OWASP ZAP | github.com/zaproxy/zaproxy | Java (add-on marketplace via `ExtensionAutoUpdate`) | Y — full add-on marketplace/updater | chk: auto by default (`CHECK_ADDON_UPDATES` default **true**, throttled to once/day); dl/inst: **manual by default** (`INSTALL_ADDON_UPDATES` default **false**, `DOWNLOAD_NEW_RELEASE` default **false**) — user-configurable to fully automatic | Y — downloads `.zap` add-on JARs and loads them into the running JVM (`AddOnLoader`/`AddOnClassLoader`) | https (manifest + add-on package URLs; e.g. GitHub Releases URLs as seen in the shipped add-ons list); scheme not enforced in code, relies on URL supplied by manifest | no — manifest (ZapVersions.xml-style config) is plain XML/HTTP response, not independently signed | hash-from-manifest — SHA-256 (or other algo) embedded as `"<ALGORITHM>:<HASH>"` string inside each add-on's manifest entry, computed over the downloaded file and compared post-download | none — the "trusted" hash comes from the same unsigned manifest/transport as the payload itself (no independent signing key / root of trust) | `zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/extension/autoupdate/Downloader.java:82-128` (`validateHashDownload`, SHA compare); `zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/control/AddOn.java:594,1601` (`hash` field sourced from manifest entry); `zap/src/main/java/org/zaproxy/zap/extension/autoupdate/OptionsParamCheckForUpdates.java:43-57,82-83` (default flags); `zap/src/main/main-add-ons.yml:12-25` (example manifest entries: `url:` + `hash: "SHA-256:..."`) |
